source: NCEP AIGEFS (Project EAGLE) member forecast GRIB2 product, completed by a same-cycle physical global analysis
units_policy: terrain enters as the analysis product's surface geopotential height record in metres; no scale is applied
time_policy: the AI ensemble member supplies the evolving atmosphere at every forecast step; the borrowed land-surface state is the one analysis record of the SAME cycle, verified by the composition's source_cycle_analysis_broadcast alignment and carried unchanged to every primary valid time, with the carried times named in the receipt
member_policy: member identity belongs to the PRIMARY files and is verified by the packaged rw-wps.members.v1 grammar at member preparation; the contributing analysis is deterministic and a member-bearing donor refuses by name
absence_policy: the member product publishes no soil temperature, no soil moisture, no land mask, no orography, no skin temperature and no 2 m humidity (byte-measured, 2026-08-17 00Z cycle); every one of those gaps is declared composition_bound in the primary mapping and bound to the analysis donor -- nothing is synthesized
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
